item.name: Hydro
item.description: Units with this Element deal Hydro Element damage.
item.stageInteractions: Hydro is one of the seven Elements in the Resistance game modifier cycle (Flame > Hydro > Gale > Terra > Light > Storm > Dark every 30s). Mirror and Enemy Resistances can cut damage from this Element. Stage buffs and debuffs can also target Elements.
item.exampleUnits: Dark Mage, Dark Mage (Sovereign), Ice Queen, Water Princess, Ice Mage
item.cardSummary: Hydro combat Element for water and ice damage dealers; keep a Hydro unit ready when Resistance is cycling other Elements.

item.name: Gale
item.description: Units with this Element deal Gale Element damage.
item.stageInteractions: Gale is one of the seven Elements in the Resistance game modifier cycle (Flame > Hydro > Gale > Terra > Light > Storm > Dark every 30s). Mirror and Enemy Resistances can cut damage from this Element. Stage buffs and debuffs can also target Elements.
item.cardSummary: Gale combat Element for wind-style damage; mix it into teams so Resistance rotations do not shut down your whole roster.

item.name: Terra
item.description: Units with this Element deal Terra Element damage.
item.stageInteractions: Terra is one of the seven Elements in the Resistance game modifier cycle (Flame > Hydro > Gale > Terra > Light > Storm > Dark every 30s). Mirror and Enemy Resistances can cut damage from this Element. Stage buffs and debuffs can also target Elements.
item.cardSummary: Terra combat Element for earth-style damage; useful coverage when Resistance moves off Flame, Hydro, or Gale.

item.name: Flame
item.description: Units with this Element deal Flame Element damage.
item.stageInteractions: Flame is one of the seven Elements in the Resistance game modifier cycle (Flame > Hydro > Gale > Terra > Light > Storm > Dark every 30s). Mirror and Enemy Resistances can cut damage from this Element. Stage buffs and debuffs can also target Elements.
item.exampleUnits: Flame Emperor, Flame Emperor (Reincarnate), Hollow, Hollow (Blaze), Demon Cyborg, Nen Hunter, Curly Brow, Rubber Boy
item.cardSummary: Flame combat Element with a large unit pool; still diversify, because Resistance starts on Flame every cycle.

item.name: Storm
item.description: Units with this Element deal Storm Element damage.
item.stageInteractions: Storm is one of the seven Elements in the Resistance game modifier cycle (Flame > Hydro > Gale > Terra > Light > Storm > Dark every 30s). Mirror and Enemy Resistances can cut damage from this Element. Stage buffs and debuffs can also target Elements.
item.exampleUnits: Elf Mage, Elf Mage (Unleashed), Kid Assassin, Thunder Shinobi
item.cardSummary: Storm combat Element for lightning-style damage; covers the late part of the Resistance rotation with Light and Dark.

item.name: Light
item.description: Units with this Element deal Light Element damage.
item.stageInteractions: Light is one of the seven Elements in the Resistance game modifier cycle (Flame > Hydro > Gale > Terra > Light > Storm > Dark every 30s). Mirror and Enemy Resistances can cut damage from this Element. Stage buffs and debuffs can also target Elements.
item.exampleUnits: True Saint, True Saint (Holy), Puppet, Puppet (Telekinetic), Reaper (Released), Reaper, Reishi Archer
item.cardSummary: Light combat Element spanning Magical, Physical, and Psychic units; strong mid-to-late Resistance coverage.

item.name: Dark
item.description: Units with this Element deal Dark Element damage.
item.stageInteractions: Dark is one of the seven Elements in the Resistance game modifier cycle (Flame > Hydro > Gale > Terra > Light > Storm > Dark every 30s). Mirror and Enemy Resistances can cut damage from this Element. Stage buffs and debuffs can also target Elements.
item.exampleUnits: Crow, Crow (Black Fire), Shadow, Shadow (Divine), Crimson, Crimson (Brother), Toy Maker, Cursed Immortal, Cursed Immortal (Black Sun), Cursed Student, Cursed Student (True Love), Greed
item.cardSummary: Dark combat Element with the largest Miraheze roster; ends the Resistance cycle, so pair it with other Elements for Mirror and Resistance stages.

item.name: Neutral
item.description: Units with this Element deal Neutral Element damage.
item.stageInteractions: Neutral deals Neutral Element damage and is not listed in the Resistance rotation (Flame > Hydro > Gale > Terra > Light > Storm > Dark). Mirror can still copy deployed Elements as enemy resistances. Stage buffs and debuffs can still interact with Elements in general.
item.exampleUnits: 8th Sword, 8th Sword (Berserk), Razorjaw, Razorjaw (Hunter), String Demon, String Demon (Awakened), Bounty Hunter, Corps Captain
item.cardSummary: Neutral combat Element outside the seven-step Resistance cycle; still useful for Mirror planning because enemies can copy your deployed Elements.

item.name: Farm
item.description: Farm units generate Yen at the end of every wave instead of focusing on combat.
item.stageInteractions: Farm is an economy Element, not a combat damage type in the Resistance cycle. The No Farms game modifier disables Farm units. Farm is not listed in the Resistance rotation.
item.cardSummary: Economy Element that earns Yen each wave; bring Farm for income stages, and drop them when No Farms is active.
